title: Not until: событие после условия
description: Not until: событие после условия: чтение оригинального текста, контекстный словарь и точное описание ситуации с объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Найти в тексте ответ на вопрос «Что должно предшествовать публикации?»
Различать значения sequence и release в теме «Not until: событие после условия»
notes: В предложении «The release is dependent on authorisation.» подлежащее в единственном числе согласуется с is.
При чтении важно сохранить факт или границу вывода: «Immediate delivery upon recording permission alone.»

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

public_payload.passage: The archive would not release the photographs until the donor’s permission had been recorded. A researcher read the rule as a promise that recording permission alone would guarantee immediate delivery. The archivist explained that the wording established a temporal restriction, while the accompanying procedure still required a condition check and preparation of copies. Permission was necessary before release, but the rule did not abolish those later steps. Another reader had made the opposite mistake, treating the temporary restriction as a permanent refusal. The archivist’s clarification preserved the possibility of release without inventing a guarantee about its precise timing or removing the stated prerequisites.

options.label: A permanent refusal of every request.

exercises.explanation: Ответ подтверждён текстом: «Recording the donor’s permission.». Другие варианты изменяют указанное обстоятельство.
